page_template.$comment: Generated at load time from the slot model in klartex/page_templates.py (page_template_schema); see registry.py.

number_format.description: Number format for amounts: 'sv' gives 32 400,00 (default), 'en' gives 32,400.00.

logo.description: Image file (pdf/png) shown in the invoice body's top-left corner, aligned with the FAKTURA block. A plain file name is looked up via the asset directory (the page template's directory) and cwd.

logo_height.description: Logo height as a LaTeX dimension, e.g. '1.5cm'.

logo_offset.description: Fine-tunes the logo position, as fractions of its height: positive x moves right (negative left), positive y moves up (negative down). E.g. {"y": 0.25} when the artwork has built-in padding. Starting point: left edge at the margin, top edge aligned with the FAKTURA heading.

footer.description: Not a property of this template. Company, contact and payment details go in the page template's footer slot: `page_template.footer` with variant `columns` and its `fields`.

sender.description: Sender/seller — shown as its own block next to the recipient in the invoice body. Give the company's legal name here even when a logo or a page-template footer is present.

bankgiro.description: Fallback: payment details belong in the page template's footer slot (`page_template.footer.fields`). The in-body block is suppressed when those structured fields carry a payment detail; a custom footer source or whole-page source is not inspected, so a caller whose own source prints payment details omits these fields.

note.description: Optional note shown below the invoice content.
